title: names
summary: MSUI implements all three ask-once name paths: player GUID, creature template entry plus GUID, and pet number plus GUID. Player answers strictly parse the full 1.12 guid/name/realm/race/gender/class body, cache negative answers, and retain positive traits; pet answers are strictly parsed, cached by pet number, and consumed by nameplates, target frame, world tooltip, pet frame, and command labels.

openItems.text: CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY (u32 petNumber + u64 guid) has no sender - a pet's guid embeds a pet number, not a template entry, so CreatureQuery cannot name one
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: WorldSession and NetworkClient send opcode 0x0052 with exact u32 pet number + full u64 GUID bytes; the ask-once pending set is keyed by pet number.

openItems.text: SMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE not parsed (pets/other players' pets stay nameless)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: PetNamePackets strictly parses u32 pet number, cstring name, and u32 timestamp from opcode 0x0053, and GameLoop caches the display name by pet number.
